whatItIs: quantumflow is an open-source project in the compilers and languages category. It is maintained by rigetti and primarily looks like a Python codebase. >Notice: This is research code that will not necessarily be maintained to >support further releases of Forest and other Rigetti Software.

The repository README emphasizes: >Notice: This is research code that will not necessarily be maintained to >support further releases of Forest and other Rigetti Software.
